title: Rassimov's files
summary: Rassimov's files are files contained in a dossier with information on Rassimov and his weaknesses. They were kept and put together by Simon Judeau in a hidden safe on his room inside his castle. According to Grier and Dante Vale, The Professor suspected Rassimov's betrayal of the Organization, explaining why he would want to keep tabs on him and store the information. After acquiring the files, the Huntik team made use of the information inside them to elaborate a plan to capture Rassimov.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
When the Huntik team came to Sutos Island to ask Grier's help in defeating the Blood Spiral, he said he could assist them in raiding the Professor's castle to potentially get information on the Spiral's leader, Rassimov. Grier and Dante agreed that the Professor was no fool and must have been at least partially aware of Rassimov's betrayal of the Organization, and was probably keeping files on him. Upon getting to the castle, Wilder revealed that he also wanted the files, but to blackmail the Spirals to work for him instead of defeating them. As the team out powered him and Hoffman, Lok Lambert and Den Fears retrieved the files from within a hidden safe in the Professor's room. [An Ally from the Organization]

After Metz received the files, the Foundation was able to work out a battle plan to capture Rassimov given the information contained inside them, part of The Eye of the Storm mission. The mission was initially successful as the team ambushed Rassimov by the Tomb of Tutankhamun, countering his every move with coordinated attacks, which resulted in him being restrained and taken away in a Huntik Foundation vehicle. However, disaster struck when Harrison Fears freed Rassimov, who invoked Legion, a Legendary Titan hidden inside his body. The team managed to escape, but only after severe damage was already done. [Rassimov's Secret]

As the team out powered him and Hoffman, Lok Lambert and Den Fears retrieved the files from within a hidden safe in the Professor's room. [An Ally from the Organization]

After Metz received the files, the Foundation was able to work out a battle plan to capture Rassimov given the information contained inside them, part of The Eye of the Storm mission.
